The generated tier catches up with the API's multi-entity step: a graph is
one reporting group, and every ledger operation can name which entity of it
to act on. Nothing on the stable tier changes shape; one generated-tier
removal and one path move are named below.

## New: entities in a reporting group

`api.robo_ledger_setup.create_entity` with `CreateEntityRequest`
(`POST /extensions/roboledger/{graph_id}/operations/create-entity`) adds a
subsidiary to the graph's group: a name, its legal form, the share the parent
holds (`ownership_pct`), an optional `parent_entity_id` to nest it under
another subsidiary, and an optional `ticker`, which prefixes the entity's
account names and must be unique in the graph (409). `LedgerEntityResponse`
gains `ownership_pct`.

`entity_id` is a new optional field on `UpdateEntityRequest`,
`InitializeLedgerRequest`, `SetCloseTargetOperation`, `ClosePeriodOperation`,
`ReopenPeriodOperation`, `BackfillPlanHistoryOperation`,
`InitializeChartOfAccountsRequest`, `CreateReportRequest`,
`LinkEntityTaxonomyRequest`, `CreateEventBlockRequest` and
`LiveFinancialStatementRequest`. Omitted, each acts on the group parent, so
every existing call behaves as before. `FiscalCalendarResponse` and
`ReportResponse` carry `entity_id`.

`LiveFinancialStatementRequest.consolidated` renders the group's combined
statement on the parent — every entity under the parent's Reporting Style,
summed per concept, with nothing eliminated between them — and
`LiveFinancialStatementResponse` carries `entity_id`, `consolidated` and
`combined_entity_ids`.

The checked-in GraphQL schema gains `entityId` on `entity`,
`fiscalCalendar`, `periodCloseStatus`, `periodDrafts`, `openReceivables`,
`openPayables`, `openReceivablesByAgent`, `openPayablesByAgent`,
`eventBlocks`, `summary`, `accounts`, `accountTree`, `accountRollups`,
`reconciliations`, `trialBalance`, `transactions`, `closingBookStructures`,
`journalEntries` and `reports`; `LedgerEntity` gains `ownershipPct` and
`LedgerSummary` `entityId`. The checked-in operations are unchanged, so the
generated GraphQL models are too.

## Removed: `api.graphs.select_graph`

The API deprecated the graph-scoped select in favour of `set_selected_graph`
— the replacement 2.7.0 shipped — and has now removed the endpoint, so the
generated function would only ever have met a 404. No facade wrapped it and
the integration template's emit path never imported it; this is a
generated-tier removal riding a minor. `api.user.set_selected_graph` is the
call.

## Moved: `validate_schema`

`api.schema.validate_schema` is now `api.graphs.validate_schema`: the API
retagged the operation under Graphs, and a package path follows its tag. The
function, its request and its response are unchanged; update the import. No
facade wrapped it and the template never imported it.
